quote.text: How do I organise a multi-stop trip without a spreadsheet

promise.text: Multi-stop trip planner: organize it without a spreadsheet

art.why: the carousel's topic: the moment and its guide name "trip", "stop"

lines.text: Many stops mean many bookings that rest on each other.
Record four things per booking, in time order, and skip the rebuild after every change.

head.text: List the fixed points first: anything with a reference and a time.

body.text: Flights, trains, stays, tours and reserved dinners.

head.text: Put them in time order, not by stop.

body.text: The order you'll live them in is the order you'll need them.

line.text: Destinations, bookings, travellers and documents in one place, with the shape of the trip held for you rather than in your head.
